sources.entry: Muzzle - A simple mac app to silence embarrassing notifications while screensharing.

summary.name: Muzzle
summary.one_liner: Muzzle is a simple Mac app that automatically turns on Do Not Disturb when screensharing starts, so embarrassing notifications stay silent.
use_cases: Hide personal notifications during a Zoom call screenshare
Keep chat pings from appearing while presenting a Slack screen
Avoid embarrassing popups during a Google Hangouts demo
Silence notifications automatically when sharing a BlueJeans or Join Me screen
summary.what_it_does: Muzzle automatically turns on Do Not Disturb when screensharing begins, so notifications do not pop up on the shared screen. The page says it works with almost everything and names Slack, Join Me, Google Hangouts, Zoom and BlueJeans as examples. It is described as a simple Mac app. The page does not describe settings, configuration options or how detection works in detail.
notable: Automatically enables Do Not Disturb when screensharing starts
Works with apps including Slack, Zoom, Google Hangouts, BlueJeans and Join Me
Listed in awesome-mac under Collaboration and Team Tools
caveats: Pricing and download terms are not stated on the page
Mac-only; no other platforms are named
Copyright is 2020 and release notes are linked, so the app may not be actively maintained (unconfirmed)
